items.title: Persist INIT scope boundary and execution boundary artifacts
items.context: Create typed story artifacts for user-confirmed allowed/excluded scope and pre-worktree execution boundaries. Canonical boundary source is scope-boundary.json created from story_create inputs or explicit INIT-only scope_boundary_set repair. Missing scope boundary or execution boundary is a hard INIT_CHECK blocker; implementation must not infer whole-project scope from absent fields.

happy.desc: scope-boundary and execution-boundary artifacts persist with canonical user-confirmed allowed/excluded scope and can be read back by store helpers

edge.desc: missing scope boundary or execution boundary is represented as a hard missing-artifact condition, not as allow-all scope

adversarial.desc: malformed boundary arrays, unsafe paths, or blank boundary terms are rejected before gate evidence can be written

items.userSees: User sees `Scope boundary saved for B-85ba: allowed=... excluded=...` after explicit boundary capture, and `Scope freeze check saved for B-85ba: PASS` instead of an inferred allow-all boundary.

items.title: Add scope freeze check and extension proposal commands
items.context: Implement INIT-only commands for scope_freeze_check and scope_extension_proposal/decision, with signatures or freshness hashes where gate-consumed. INIT reviewers must propose expansion rather than mutating checklist scope.

happy.desc: scope_boundary_set, execution_boundary_set, scope_freeze_check, scope_extension_proposal, and scope_extension_decide are registered and enforce INIT-only command semantics

edge.desc: accepted scope extension invalidates stale freeze-check evidence and requires a rerun before INIT_CHECK

adversarial.desc: reviewer proposal command cannot directly accept expansion or mutate checklist scope

items.userSees: User sees explicit INIT commands for boundary, freeze check, and scope extension proposal/decision, with phase errors outside INIT.

items.title: Block INIT_CHECK on missing or failed anti-expansion evidence
items.context: Wire the new facts into canEnterInitCheck/getGuardFailureReason and story_advance pre-worktree ordering so failures stop before worktree creation or token-heavy development begins.

happy.desc: INIT_CHECK succeeds only after fresh scope-freeze evidence passes, existing init-check reviewers pass, and no extension proposal is pending

edge.desc: missing scope boundary, missing execution boundary, stale freeze check, and pending proposal each produce a distinct guard failure reason

adversarial.desc: blocking failures happen before worktree creation or phase mutation, leaving the story in INIT

items.userSees: User sees INIT_CHECK blocked with a specific scope anti-expansion reason before any worktree path is created.

items.title: Enforce excluded keyword and discard digest protections
items.context: Detect future-capability keywords and repeated discarded-story directions only from bounded sources: story title/description/background/checklist title/context/excludes plus discard-digest.json summaries. correctness_fix stories get the default future denylist; other modes only enforce user-confirmed excludedScope/excludedKeywords. False positives are handled by explicit scope extension proposal acceptance or repeatMitigation, not by silently broadening the classifier/audit subsystem.

happy.desc: correctness_fix stories block default future denylist keywords in story/checklist text before INIT_CHECK

edge.desc: feature/refactor stories do not use correctness-fix default denylist unless excluded keywords are explicitly user-confirmed

adversarial.desc: discarded-story digest overlap blocks repeat creation unless repeatMitigation is recorded

items.userSees: User sees future-scope keywords or repeated discarded direction blocked unless explicit scope acceptance or mitigation is recorded.

items.title: Cover process-fact registry, CLI schemas, prompts, and smoke tests
items.context: Register all gate-consumed scope anti-expansion facts, update CLI schemas/command policies and reviewer prompts, then add focused smoke tests plus contract verification so the behavior cannot regress to prompt-only guidance.

happy.desc: process-fact registry lists every new gate-consumed anti-expansion artifact/command and contract verifier passes

edge.desc: docs and reviewer prompt state that INIT reviewers propose expansion and cannot mutate scope directly

adversarial.desc: removing a required artifact fact or lifecycle artifact filename causes the smoke/contract checks to fail

items.userSees: User sees build, scope-anti-expansion smoke, process-fact contract, and lattice validate evidence recorded against every checklist intent.
